_comment: Judgments-as-data for duplicate/overlap detection and reuse search. dimension_weights are relative and sum to 1.0; they are renormalised over the dimensions both reports actually populate, so the ratios matter more than the absolute numbers.
_thresholds_comment: identical: same query and field list, differing only cosmetically. near_duplicate: one is a variant or copy of the other. overlapping: substantial shared surface, worth consolidating onto one model. related: shares a subject area only, reported for context, never auto-actioned.
_cluster_comment: A pair must reach cluster_min_similarity to join a consolidation cluster. Clusters below action_min_similarity are proposed for review rather than a concrete merge or retire.
_candidate_comment: Blocking: only pairs sharing at least one table, or min_shared_columns columns, are scored, which keeps a whole-estate sweep near-linear instead of O(n^2).
_reuse_comment: Weights for does a report like this already exist. Term overlap dominates because the request is natural language, not a schema.
